stem:
Oscar buys his lunch in the school cafeteria. The cost of 15 school lunches is $33.75.

Which graph has a slope that best represents the average cost of the lunches in dollars per lunch?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph showing points increasing approximately from (1,2) to (8,18) with linear trend.

options.label: B
options.text: Graph showing points at scattered locations low on the y-axis, increasing slowly.

options.label: C
options.text: Graph showing points at (1,14) and (2,7) and (0,0).

options.label: D
options.text: Graph showing two points at (4,1) and (8,2).

visual_elements: Four coordinate graphs labeled A, B, C, D with y-axis labeled Total Cost (dollars) and x-axis labeled Number of School Lunches, each showing data points as described in options.
notes: The problem involves interpreting slope from four graph options; data points and axes have been described for clarity.
